args.head: fix/fin-212-half-even-rounding
args.title: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money per FIN-212
args.body:
Fixes the nightly build failure in tests/test_money.py.

`round_money` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 specifies banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), which the docstring and test already describe. This changes only the rounding mode in src/money.py.

Verification: CI run ci-0001 passed on commit 08d3cd5986.

Merging requires code-owner approval per policy, and this is needed for today's release.
